meta.tagline: Study in Istanbul, the easy way
meta.description: Eduways Academy helps Persian-speaking students get admitted to the best universities in Istanbul and Turkey — with negotiated discounts, scholarships, visa, flights and accommodation handled end-to-end.

common.whatsappMessage: Hello Eduways! I'd like a free consultation about studying in Istanbul.

home.heroTitle: Your seat at a top Istanbul university, <accent>arranged end to end.</accent>

home.trustLine: Trusted by students from Iran, Afghanistan, Tajikistan and the diaspora
home.whySubtitle: We are not a listing site. We are the team that gets you in and settles you down.
home.why1Body: We map your grades, budget and goals to universities where you will actually get accepted — then file everything for you.
home.why2Body: Thanks to direct agreements with universities, we secure tuition discounts and scholarships of up to 75%.
home.why3Body: Flights, airport pickup, accommodation, residence permit (ikamet), SIM card, bank account — we are with you on the ground.
home.why4Body: Persian-speaking advisors, clear pricing, written agreements and a WhatsApp line that actually answers.
home.featuredSubtitle: Hand-picked for value, ranking and international student support.

home.process3Body: We translate, notarize and file documents on your behalf.
home.process4Body: We negotiate tuition and scholarships and confirm your seat.
home.process5Body: Visa, flight, housing, residence permit and orientation in Istanbul.

rankings.byFieldHint: Pick a field to see the best Istanbul universities for it.
rankings.sourceNote: Sources: URAP, THE and QS (latest available year per university). Eduways score is our editorial assessment, updated yearly.
rankings.methodologyBody: We take the best available national rank from URAP, THE and QS and combine it with tuition to compute a value score, then layer our editorial score based on admissions experience, English support and student services. Sources are linked so you can verify.
